In this scenario, the net effect of $1 moved from banks to a stablecoin issuer would still decrease bank lending by around $0.50 but increase total Treasury holdings by $0.30. measurement_scope_and_exclusions: Scenario arithmetic in one Economic Bulletin article. Not a universal marginal effect and not a cap.
